# Peg Master Bartending Academy

> Bartending academy in Pune, Maharashtra, India, founded by Avdhut Mirkale ("Peg Master Avdhut"). It teaches professional bartending, mixology and flair bartending hands-on at a real bar counter, with a certificate on completion and career guidance. Enquiries and admissions are handled on WhatsApp at +91 99224 25833.

## Key facts

- Name: Peg Master Bartending Academy
- Location: Pune, Maharashtra, India
- Founder and mentor: Avdhut Mirkale, known as Peg Master Avdhut, a spirits and cocktail creator with 138K+ Instagram followers and 143K+ YouTube subscribers. His most-watched YouTube Short has 47M views (October 2026).

## Courses

- [Professional Bartending](https://pegmasterbartendingacademy.in/#courses): for beginners. The full foundation, from your first jigger to running a busy bar. Covers bar tools and speed pouring; spirits, liqueurs, beer and wine; classic and modern cocktails; bar setup and hygiene; guest service and interview preparation. Weekday and weekend batches.
- [Advanced Mixology & Flair](https://pegmasterbartendingacademy.in/#courses): for working bartenders. Working and exhibition flair, fire flair under supervision, signature cocktail creation, garnish and glassware, and building a social-media presence.
- [Home Bartending Workshop](https://pegmasterbartendingacademy.in/#courses): for enthusiasts. A weekend session on setting up a home bar, easy classics and mocktails, measuring, shaking and stirring, and hosting tips.

Every course includes real bar practice, small batches, a certificate and career guidance.

## What students learn

- Spirits knowledge: whisky, rum, vodka, gin, tequila and liqueurs
- Cocktail craft: classics, modern twists and balancing flavours
- Flair bartending: bottle and tin tricks, working flair and fire flair
- Garnish and presentation
- Bar operations: setup, hygiene, inventory and costing
- Guest experience: responsible serving and upselling

## Careers after the course

5-star hotels, bars and lounges, clubs and pubs, cruise lines, weddings and events, jobs abroad, brand ambassador roles, or opening your own bar.

## Frequently asked questions

- Do I need any prior experience? No. The Professional Bartending course starts from the basics.
- What are the fees and batch timings? Fees depend on the course and batch; message the academy on WhatsApp for current fees, dates and timings.
- Will I get a certificate? Yes. Every student who completes a course receives a Peg Master Bartending Academy certificate.
- Do you help with jobs after the course? Yes, with interview preparation, CV tips and industry contacts.
- Is there an age requirement? Students must meet the legal age requirement for handling and tasting alcohol under Maharashtra law.
